changelog: **Session guides — the admin library (#1843, part 2):** `/admin/agenda-templates` (sidebar: *Session guides*, `mentorship` capability, gated layout) curates the guided-conversation library of #1841 in EN/TR/DE: title, a "when to use it" summary and the ordered prompts with an optional mentor-only facilitation note, with search (`data-testid="agenda-template-search"`) and use-count sort. `/api/admin/agenda-templates` mirrors `goal-templates`: `GET` (live guides with prompts, most-used first), `POST` (canonical title = the default locale's wording; the same title twice is 409, a retired title is revived in place so held sessions stay attached), `PATCH` (title/summary/prompts; prompts sent with their id are reworded and reordered in place so a held session keeps following them, unlisted prompts are removed and the held line falls back to its snapshot text — SetNull), `DELETE` archives, never removes (#1113). Prompts are bounded like to-do titles (VARCHAR 191), summaries at 500, notes at 2000, 30 prompts per guide. E2E `e2e/agenda-templates-admin.spec.ts`.

en: Administrators can now manage the library of session guides under Session guides: write a conversation once in English, Turkish and German, with its prompts and a note for the mentor, reword it later and every session that used it follows, or retire it without touching sessions already held.
tr: Yöneticiler artık oturum rehberleri kütüphanesini Oturum rehberleri altında yönetebilir: bir konuşmayı sorularıyla ve mentora notuyla İngilizce, Türkçe ve Almanca bir kez yaz, sonra düzelt — onu kullanan her oturum takip eder — ya da yapılmış oturumlara dokunmadan kaldır.
de: Administratoren verwalten die Bibliothek der Gesprächsleitfäden jetzt unter Gesprächsleitfäden: ein Gespräch einmal auf Englisch, Türkisch und Deutsch schreiben, mit Fragen und einem Hinweis für die Mentor-Seite, später umformulieren — jede Sitzung, die es nutzt, folgt — oder zurückziehen, ohne bereits gehaltene Sitzungen anzurühren.
